what_happened.line: The Select Board and Park Commissioners, meeting jointly, appointed Corinne Scouten to a vacant park commission seat on a 4-3 vote.
The board voted down a motion to interview all conservation candidates and two incumbents, then reappointed one conservation incumbent and held the other seat open.
The board reappointed one incumbent each to the agricultural and historical commissions, and appointed members to the historical commission and personnel committee.
A financial adviser outlined outstanding school project bond anticipation notes and planned bond issues running through 2017.
The board terminated the Jones House land development agreement and approved licenses, nine constable appointments and one ambulance bill abatement.

why_it_matters: School construction borrowing through 2017 is a long-term debt commitment that is paid from the town budget, mostly taxes, so the schedule the adviser described bears on future tax bills.
Who sits on the park commission and conservation commission affects decisions on field maintenance and land use, and a joint meeting on field ownership and upkeep is planned.
watch_next: Next Select Board meeting, set for the 26th.
A joint meeting of selectmen, park commission and finance committee on field ownership and maintenance, date not yet set.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary:
The two records agree on most appointments, licenses, the abatement and the main figures. The official minutes also cover many items we did not capture, such as the Council on Aging and the records request.
A person should check three points on the recording: the 145 Page Street outcome, which we could not hear; the conservation vote tallies and whether interviews were actually decided; and the second Transitions figure of $159,242, which the official minutes do not have.
